fields.statement: At 7bfe3f64 ran go test -trimpath -count=1 -v ./internal/tui/inboxapp/...: all 12 tests pass, plus go vet and gofmt clean. With the fake runner, TestAnswerQuestionSendsSessionMessage shows Enter on a question opens a Form with one TextArea ("Your answer"); submitting "Use sqlite" calls session.message [S1, Use sqlite] and returns tea.Quit. TestAnswerBlockerCallsQuestionAnswer shows a blocker submits question.answer [which-db, C5, sqlite] and quits. TestAnswerEscAndEmptyCallNothing shows an empty submit neither quits nor calls anything, and cancelling quits with only the initial inbox load call. Read the diff: Update quits on FormCancelledMsg and on an esc key while the form shows, before any run call; send trims the text and returns nil when it is empty; cmd/rhiza/tui.go maps the three-arg question.answer call to --change plus question and text, matching QuestionAnswerRequest.
